parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: The leg of the pliers is the handle portion, typically made of steel with a rubber coating for grip and comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It provides leverage and allows the user to apply force to the jaws of the pliers.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint when the pliers are opened or closed.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: The outlier is one of the jaw extensions of the pliers, made of hardened carbon steel for durability.
parts.Functional_description: It grips, twists, or cuts materials depending on the pliers' design.
parts.Movement_description: It moves in coordination with the other jaw around the pivot point.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: This is the second jaw extension of the pliers, also made of hardened carbon steel.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with the first outlier to grip or cut objects securely.
parts.Movement_description: It moves opposite to the first outlier around the pivot joint.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the central pivot and connecting structure of the pliers, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the two legs and jaws, allowing them to pivot and function as a single tool.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing rotational movement of the legs and jaws around the pivot.
